title: Design & spec minirag-mcp v1
description: Brainstorm -> design doc -> spec review. Python rewrite of shinpr/mcp-local-rag: fastmcp + markitdown (ingest, recursive dir scan) + trafilatura (HTML main-content extraction, markitdown fallback) + fastembed (default paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2) + LanceDB (hybrid search). v1 scope: MCP server (9 tools, parity) + CLI (same index, typer/argparse). No PDF visual mode, no ingest_url. All docs and functionality in English.

title: Deferred: ingest_url tool (server-side web fetch)
description: Server fetches URL itself and extracts main content. Deferred from v1 by user decision (2026-08-07). Implementation note (verified 2026-08-07): markitdown ships convert_url()/convert_uri() plus special converters for YouTube/Wikipedia/RSS out of the box, so fetching is nearly free — combine with trafilatura for main-content extraction of generic pages. Keep the offline-after-model-download privacy promise clear in docs if this ships.
